mac@SSH=HMAC-SHA2-256 HMAC-SHA2-512

risk.reason: Setting the crypto policy to FIPS could cause users to lose access to their yum repositories and ssh if their keys are not a supported type.

On FIPS-enabled systems this applies the FIPS policy plus the STIG subpolicy instead of plain FIPS. The subpolicy only restricts the SSH ciphers and MACs that FIPS already allows. It relies on crypto_policy::ensure resolving to FIPS, which crypto_policy.ensure.fips sets for the same rules; with any other ensure value it would replace FIPS on a FIPS-enabled system.
